jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Acquisitions
jobs.location: Chicago, IL, United States, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
jobs.description:
Who we are:

At SpotHero, we work as a team to empower people to get everywhere, easier! We’re rapidly growing with the mission of bringing the parking industry into the future through technology. Drivers across the nation use the SpotHero mobile app or website to reserve convenient, affordable parking in advance, on-the-go, or through their connected cars, and parking companies rely on us to help them reach new customers while optimizing their business. We connect the dots with cutting-edge technology, delivering value to both sides of this exciting, evolving marketplace.  We’ve been quite busy; take a peek at some of our recent announcements .

Senior Product Manager at SpotHero:

The Senior Product Manager, Acquisition is responsible for identifying and executing on the highest-leverage opportunities to bring new drivers to SpotHero. You'll own the acquisition roadmap end-to-end across our top-of-funnel, going deep on the levers that turn first impressions into a first booking. While the charter is acquisition, the canvas is every place a driver could discover SpotHero before they've ever heard of us. Expect to ideate expansively across SEO/AEO, landing pages, and search funnel experiences to give drivers everything they need to make a purchase decision. This role also works across partner distribution channels through white label or co-branded landing pages, widgets, and anywhere else we can hand partners a way to list SpotHero parking on their own site. You’ll bring all of these touchpoints together into a single strategy to grow new users on SpotHero.

What will you do:

- Drive 3-5 Year Strategy: Lead the development of long-term product visions that moves SpotHero’s current offerings into new and exciting places.

- Product Growth and Expansion: With an understanding of the company’s competitive position, balance continued growth in areas with proven product-market fit while identifying and developing new product opportunities.

- Lead High Visibility Initiatives: Own high-risk, high-reward "Strategic Bets" that require deep cross-functional coordination, such as major partner integrations or transformative marketplace shifts.

- New Product Innovation: Facilitate discovery for unmet market opportunities. You will lead the high growth phase of existing and new products, validating hypotheses through rapid prototyping and experimentation before transitioning them to dedicated squads.

- Influence Without Authority: Serve as a peer-coach to fellow PMs, helping to level up the organization’s overall product craft, documentation standards, and discovery methodologies.

- Executive Evangelism: Act as the primary product voice for your product offerings and expanding adjacencies, translating complex technical roadmaps into clear business impact stories.

Who you are:

- Strategic Architect: You excel at finding clarity in ambiguity and can map out short term and long term roadmaps that anticipate market shifts. You generate insights and ideas that create a competitive advantage.

- Master of Discovery: You lead by "design thinking" first. You are comfortable running workshops, interviewing customers and stakeholders, and using generative research to kill bad ideas early and double down on winners.

- Prioritizes Business Impact: Evaluates business value and costs when determining which opportunities the team should tackle. Applies that analysis to ideas originating from the team as well as stakeholder requests.

- Systems Thinker: You understand the interlocking nature of a two-sided marketplace. You see how a change in the driver’s search experience impacts the operator’s remit and the support team’s contact rate.

- Manages Complexity: You make good calls with incomplete information, can hold contradictory inputs without paralysis, and know when to act decisively versus when to slow down and de-risk.

- Mission-Driven: Defines and tracks success metrics aligned with company mission, prioritizing high-impact outcomes informed by market research, data analysis, and business needs.

- Global Mindset: Focuses on how the contributions of a single initiative enable success for the entire company, not just one squad.

- Relationship Building: Investing in high-level relationships with executive leadership and external partners to achieve shared goals.

What you bring:

- 5+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of launching and scaling success on the consumer side of a marketplace or ecommerce product.

- Hands-on experience shipping and iterating on landing page and search funnels, with a strong grasp of technical SEO (site architecture, schema, performance).

- Expert-level experimentation skills: Deep experience with A/B testing platforms (Optimizely), product analytics (Mixpanel, Looker), and behavioral research.

- Deep analytical skills: Strong proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Mode) or SQL.

- Technical fluency: Comfortable working with APIs and complex system architectures, and — most importantly — knows how to partner effectively with data science teams to scope, ship, and measure ML-powered features

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience; MBA or technical background preferred.

- Strong communication and storytelling skills — able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

- Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment within a tech company.

- Prior experience with SEO, conversion funnel optimization, Martech, and growth levers in a consumer marketplace or ecommerce setting is a strong plus.

We don’t expect you to check all of the boxes! If you meet a few of them or are interested, still apply! We'd love to meet you + hear how you can help SpotHero drive into the future.

Seeking Candidates in:

- Chicago, IL

- Toronto, ON

What we are offering:

- Career game changer – A truly unique experience to work for a fast-growing company in a role with unlimited growth potential.

- Excellent benefits

- We cover a generous portion of Medical Premiums, 50% of Dental and Vision Premiums, company-sponsored Life Insurance, STD, and AD&D coverage, a 401(k) with match and immediate vesting, and comprehensive leave policies to meet your needs in creating space for life.

- Canada: We offer Medical (prescription drug and paramedical coverage), Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, STD, and LTD.

- Flexible PTO policy and outstanding work/life balance – We value and support each individual team member.

- UberEats weekly lunch stipend for in-office days

- Udemy License and Personal Learning Budget – We support the professional and personal growth of our people by providing everyone with learning resources and development opportunities.

- Annual parking stipend – Duh. We help people park!

- The opportunity to collaborate with fun, innovative, and passionate people in a casual yet highly productive atmosphere.

- Our commitment to allyship has been a central driver of how we Respect Fellow Drivers. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of Employee Resource Groups, access allyship learning resources, and actively contribute to our ongoing effort of making SpotHero inclusive for all.

- Employee programs to grow and support our people such as Discovery Days for Product and Engineering, Gearing up for Aspiring Leaders, and Mentorship Program.

- Wellness program – a workplace that actively supports your physical and mental wellbeing through ongoing events, initiatives, resources, and thoughtful perks and benefits.

- A workplace recognized as  CityLights award winner  by 1871,  2026 Best Places To Work  by BuiltIn,  Most Loved Workplace Certified  by the Best Practice Institute, and recipient of multiple Comparably awards, including  Best Company Culture, Best Company for Women, and Best Company for Diversity.

Compensation in Illinois :

Depending on your skillset and experience, you can expect your base salary to be between $116,000 - $145,000 as well as a discretionary bonus and leading total rewards package.

Compensation in Ontario:

Depending on your skillset and experience, you can expect your base salary to be between CA$128,000 - $160,000 as well as a discretionary bonus and leading total rewards package.

At SpotHero, we Respect Fellow Drivers by providing an inclusive interview experience for everyone, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process. Please let our team know of your need when you apply or as you begin interviewing with our team.

SpotHero is an equal opportunity employer. We know that a diverse workforce is the strongest workforce, and are committed to building and supporting an inclusive environment for all.Additionally, because we want to Remember to Signal, if you choose to provide us personal information in connection with a job application, please review our  Applicant Privacy Notice  which provides details about what information we collect and process about you in order to consider your candidacy.

PLEASE NOTE: This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship. To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the US or Canada and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future.
